Trailer.title: Gameplay Trailer
Trailer.description: The gameplay trailer of WARD 21 is out now on YouTube! Watch the thrilling survival horror experience unfold and get a glimpse of the abandoned hospital, terrifying creatures, and challenging puzzles.

news.title: Latest Update Live Now!
news.description: WARD 21 version 0.4 is live! Discover the behind-the-scenes science and design of WARD 21. All bugs fixed, gameplay tested, animations polished, and new features added. Get ready to explore the abandoned hospital like never before.
